trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies first and this one pops on its own the moment the last of them lands. Work through the roadmap in order — story chapters, then story missions and stranger strands, then activities, collectibles, robberies and money, and the long grinds last — and keep a manual save at the start of every chapter, because the game has no mission replay (OutputLag). Do not turn cheats on during the run: PowerPyx reports that cheats disable trophies (via PlanetGTA6). Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade; OutputLag — no mission replay, about 200 hours for the platinum; PlanetGTA6 / PowerPyx — cheats disable trophies.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
sources: OutputLag — no mission replay; ~200-hour platinum estimate

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, through to its end. It is the first mission of the game, so this unlocks naturally as the story starts and cannot be missed. Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade; KeenGamer — opening mission.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. Story chapters unlock in order, so this comes from playing the story through; keep a manual save at the start of the chapter in case you want to replay its missions later, since there is no mission replay (OutputLag). Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade; OutputLag — no mission replay.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. The asterisks are part of the official name as PlayStation publishes it. Most of the open-world list opens up once both protagonists are playable in Chapter 2 (OutputLag), so use this chapter to start sampling activities and collectibles between missions. Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade; OutputLag — Chapter 2 opens up the world.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
sources: OutputLag — Chapter 2 opens up the world

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. Robbery trophies start unlocking in Chapters 3 and 4 (OutputLag), so begin the robbery side content — bank vaults, the armored truck, the jewelry store — once this chapter opens it up. Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade; OutputLag — robberies unlock in Chapters 3 and 4.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
sources: OutputLag — robberies unlock in Chapters 3 and 4

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4. By the end of this chapter the robbery set is fully available (OutputLag), so clear any robbery trophies you have not done yet before pushing on to the finale. Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade; OutputLag — robberies unlock in Chapters 3 and 4.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
sources: OutputLag — robberies unlock in Chapters 3 and 4

trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. Before you start it, make a manual save: there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus (OutputLag), so the finale is a one-shot in this playthrough, and any cleanup you still need should be done first. Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade; OutputLag — no mission replay, save before the final mission.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
sources: OutputLag — no mission replay; save before the final mission

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run when it appears in the story. Named story missions unlock as the chapters progress, so keep playing the story and this one arrives on its own. Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist when it appears in the story. It is a named story mission, so it unlocks by playing the chapters in order. Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play when it appears in the story. It is a named story mission, so it unlocks by playing the chapters in order. Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners when it appears in the story. It is a named story mission, so it unlocks by playing the chapters in order. Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown when it appears in the story. It is a named story mission, so it unlocks by playing the chapters in order. Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory when it appears in the story. It is a named story mission, so it unlocks by playing the chapters in order. Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion using the game's in-game checklist. This is the hardest trophy on the list (KeenGamer) and the last one most players earn, because it needs the story, the side strands, the collectibles and the grinds all finished — the roadmap stages in this guide are the practical order. The in-game checklist is the authority on what still counts; do not trust an outside count that no source confirms. Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade; KeenGamer — hardest trophy, 100% checklist.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts across Leonida. Stunts build up while you drive, ride and jump around the map, so a large share comes naturally during the story; after the story, keep chaining jumps, near-misses and air time in free roam and watch the counter climb. Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once — one race, one fishing challenge, one arcade game, one shooting-range challenge, one drone race, and so on through everything the game offers. One try of each type is enough; you do not need to win or finish them all. This guide does not state a total number of activity types, because no cited source confirms one. Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Work through the ranges one at a time, replaying any challenge that falls short of gold until it clears — range challenges can be retried, so this is a skill grind, not a one-shot. Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade; U7BUY — 42 shooting-range gold medals.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every location the game offers. Visit each Top Fun spot and win its race; a location only counts once you have won there. This guide does not state how many locations there are, because no cited source confirms a count. Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Each race only counts once, so spread your wins across different race events instead of replaying the same one — mix street races, off-road and whatever else the map offers, and track which ones you have already won. Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Take on Cal's fishing challenge when it is available and out-fish him — fishing is one of the activities you can practise freely, so learn the timing first and then challenge him. Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. Find an arcade machine in the world, start any game on it and play it through to its end — one completed game is all it takes. Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Andy's mission strand. Side strands open as you meet their characters in the world; keep taking Andy's missions whenever they appear until his strand ends. Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Kenton's mission strand. Side strands open as you meet their characters in the world; keep taking Kenton's missions whenever they appear until his strand ends. Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Billy's mission strand. Side strands open as you meet their characters in the world; keep taking Billy's missions whenever they appear until his strand ends. Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Stranger strands are the side missions you pick up from characters met out in the world; finish eight whole strands, not just eight missions, and roam the whole state — the strands are spread across Leonida, not clustered in one city. Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Randy's mission strand. Side strands open as you meet their characters in the world; keep taking Randy's missions whenever they appear until his strand ends. Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Tyrone's mission strand. Side strands open as you meet their characters in the world; keep taking Tyrone's missions whenever they appear until his strand ends. Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. MISSABLE WARNING — the only potentially missable trophy on the list (KeenGamer): OutputLag reports that Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 counts toward this trophy and disappears after that chapter, and the game has no mission replay, so meditate at every spot you find as you go — do not leave them for after the story. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter as a safety net. Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade; KeenGamer — 18 spots, the only potentially missable trophy; OutputLag — Chapter 1 balcony spot disappears after Chapter 1, no mission replay.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
sources: KeenGamer — 18 spots; only potentially missable trophy
OutputLag — Chapter 1 balcony spot disappears after Chapter 1; no mission replay

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Take Bret's hunting strand when it appears and follow it to the unique animal he wants — this is a side strand with a specific target, not general hunting. Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida; collect full sets rather than stray singles, and keep a checklist of which sets are complete so you know which cards are still missing. Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations across Leonida. This is a long sweep of the map, so fold it into your exploration — use WAiNK It at every new place you visit instead of saving it for a dedicated run at the end. Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges cover the game's side goals and build up across everything else you do, so treat this as a cleanup trophy: check the challenge list late in the run and finish the easiest remaining ones first. Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build up a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. Do it somewhere with open roads and hiding places so you can break line of sight, and stay together with your partner until the wanted level clears. Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back without losing your wanted level — the wanted level must stay active through all three robberies. Pick three shops close together, move fast between them, and do not let the cops drop off before the third robbery is done. Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Vehicles count when you find them in the world, so drive through new areas, visit car parks, dealerships and the countryside, and hop into anything you have not seen before — variety matters more than mileage. Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a fight with a group of enemies close together, trigger Combat Focus, and chain five takedowns before it ends — a crowded shootout is the right moment, not a one-on-one. Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — the airport. Head to Vice City International Airport and leave it in a way the schedule never planned, for example by taking an aircraft out without following the usual route. The exact trigger is not yet confirmed by a cited source, so treat this as a free-roam experiment at the airport. Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Face the Rhino tanks — the description's hint is that it is hot inside them. Seek out the Rhino tank encounters in free roam and deal with them; the exact trigger is not yet confirmed by a cited source, so this is a free-roam trophy to try once tanks appear. Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet — avoid the cameras and the staff's line of sight, take what you came for, and get out before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, leave and try again. Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Each vault needs a clean getaway, so plan your exit before you go in and do not linger after the vault is open — five vaults, five escapes. Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Ambush a truck on the road, stop it, take its cargo and get away before the police close in — pick a quiet stretch of road with a fast exit. Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Drive, ride and walk into every corner of the state — cities, beaches, swamps and back roads — until the map is filled in. This guide does not state how many areas that is, because no cited source confirms a count. Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang in Leonida. Find the gangs' operations across the map and hit one per gang — every gang needs to be represented. This guide does not state how many gangs there are, because no cited source confirms a count. Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to Ocean Beach, find a spot with a view over the water and order a cocktail there. No confirmed unlock method is published at launch (OutputLag), so treat this as a free-roam moment to try on the beachfront. Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade; OutputLag — no confirmed unlock method at launch.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
sources: OutputLag — no confirmed unlock method at launch

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive into a vehicle showroom and break out through the front in a vehicle — the classic way out. No confirmed unlock method is published at launch (OutputLag), so try it in free roam at a showroom. Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade; OutputLag — no confirmed unlock method at launch.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
sources: OutputLag — no confirmed unlock method at launch

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Go to the bowling alley and play a frame of bowling there — the follow-through is the point, so finish the throw properly. Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A partnership moment with mass appeal. This is tied to something the two protagonists do together that draws a crowd; the exact trigger is not yet confirmed by a cited source, so keep playing the partner content and check the guide sources as they update. Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Make the choices the game puts in front of you, for better or worse. This trophy tracks story choices, so it comes from playing the story and choosing rather than avoiding decisions; the exact trigger is not yet confirmed by a cited source. Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm — succeed at something on your second attempt. The exact trigger is not yet confirmed by a cited source; it most likely comes from retrying something you failed once and then passing it, so do not worry about it until it pops. No confirmed unlock method is published at launch (OutputLag). Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade; OutputLag — no confirmed unlock method at launch.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
sources: OutputLag — no confirmed unlock method at launch

trophies.guide: Witness something strange out in the world. This is one of the hidden trophies with no confirmed unlock method at launch (OutputLag) — explore Leonida's odd corners and the moment should find you. Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade; OutputLag — no confirmed unlock method at launch.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
sources: OutputLag — no confirmed unlock method at launch

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee drive-by — strike from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon. No confirmed unlock method is published at launch (OutputLag), so try it in free roam once you have a vehicle and a melee weapon. Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade; OutputLag — no confirmed unlock method at launch.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
sources: OutputLag — no confirmed unlock method at launch

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and other illicit income; keep feeding them to your contacts and the total climbs. It is a long money grind, so start laundering early instead of stockpiling bills. Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in Leonida. Buy clothes, weapons, food and anything else the shops sell — spending counts everywhere, so spread it around and let it build up naturally as you gear up for the rest of the run. Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy every garage the game offers — they give you somewhere to store the vehicles you discover, so they pair well with Whip It Good. This guide does not state how many garages there are, because no cited source confirms a count. Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Each vehicle you find can be registered through the app, so register the ones you discover as you go — ten registrations is all it takes. Sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade.
trophies.name: On the Spot
